contract_deployments_metadata_check.name: contract_deployments_metadata_check
contract_deployments_metadata_check.value:
(
        "contract_deployments"."deployment_status" = 'PLANNED'
        AND "contract_deployments"."contract_address" IS NULL
        AND "contract_deployments"."deployment_tx_hash" IS NULL
        AND "contract_deployments"."deployment_block_number" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "contract_deployments"."deployment_status" = 'PENDING'
        AND "contract_deployments"."deployment_tx_hash" IS NOT NULL
        AND "contract_deployments"."deployment_block_number" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "contract_deployments"."deployment_status" IN ('CONFIRMED', 'RETIRED')
        AND "contract_deployments"."contract_address" IS NOT NULL
        AND "contract_deployments"."deployment_tx_hash" IS NOT NULL
        AND "contract_deployments"."deployment_block_number" IS NOT NULL
      ) OR "contract_deployments"."deployment_status" = 'FAILED'

ctf_conditions_status_evidence_check.name: ctf_conditions_status_evidence_check
ctf_conditions_status_evidence_check.value:
(
        "ctf_conditions"."registration_status" = 'DERIVED'
        AND "ctf_conditions"."preparation_tx_hash" IS NULL
        AND "ctf_conditions"."preparation_block_number" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "ctf_conditions"."registration_status" = 'SUBMITTED'
        AND "ctf_conditions"."preparation_tx_hash" IS NOT NULL
        AND "ctf_conditions"."preparation_block_number" IS NULL
      ) OR (
        "ctf_conditions"."registration_status" = 'PREPARED'
        AND "ctf_conditions"."preparation_tx_hash" IS NOT NULL
        AND "ctf_conditions"."preparation_block_number" IS NOT NULL
      ) OR (
        "ctf_conditions"."registration_status" = 'FAILED'
        AND "ctf_conditions"."preparation_block_number" IS NULL
      )

market_observation_specs_integer_check.name: market_observation_specs_integer_check
market_observation_specs_integer_check.value: ("market_observation_specs"."domain_lower" IS NULL OR (scale("market_observation_specs"."domain_lower") = 0 AND abs("market_observation_specs"."domain_lower") < power(10::numeric, 78))) AND ("market_observation_specs"."domain_upper" IS NULL OR (scale("market_observation_specs"."domain_upper") = 0 AND abs("market_observation_specs"."domain_upper") < power(10::numeric, 78)))

market_observation_specs_domain_check.name: market_observation_specs_domain_check
market_observation_specs_domain_check.value: "market_observation_specs"."domain_lower" IS NULL OR "market_observation_specs"."domain_upper" IS NULL OR "market_observation_specs"."domain_lower" < "market_observation_specs"."domain_upper"

market_outcomes_integer_bounds_check.name: market_outcomes_integer_bounds_check
market_outcomes_integer_bounds_check.value: ("market_outcomes"."range_lower" IS NULL OR (scale("market_outcomes"."range_lower") = 0 AND abs("market_outcomes"."range_lower") < power(10::numeric, 78))) AND ("market_outcomes"."range_upper" IS NULL OR (scale("market_outcomes"."range_upper") = 0 AND abs("market_outcomes"."range_upper") < power(10::numeric, 78)))

market_outcomes_range_check.name: market_outcomes_range_check
market_outcomes_range_check.value: "market_outcomes"."range_lower" IS NULL OR "market_outcomes"."range_upper" IS NULL OR "market_outcomes"."range_lower" < "market_outcomes"."range_upper"

markets_type_count_check.name: markets_type_count_check
markets_type_count_check.value: ("markets"."market_type" = 'BINARY' AND "markets"."outcome_count" = 2) OR ("markets"."market_type" IN ('CATEGORICAL', 'PRICE_RANGE') AND "markets"."outcome_count" BETWEEN 2 AND 256)

markets_round_identity_check.name: markets_round_identity_check
markets_round_identity_check.value: ("markets"."series_key" IS NULL AND "markets"."round_key" IS NULL) OR (length(btrim("markets"."series_key")) > 0 AND length(btrim("markets"."round_key")) > 0 AND "markets"."series_key" IS NOT NULL AND "markets"."round_key" IS NOT NULL)

markets_frozen_before_trading_check.name: markets_frozen_before_trading_check
markets_frozen_before_trading_check.value:
"markets"."trading_status" = 'NOT_STARTED'
        OR ("markets"."terms_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "markets"."terms_frozen_at" IS NOT NULL)

markets_frozen_lifecycle_check.name: markets_frozen_lifecycle_check
markets_frozen_lifecycle_check.value:
"markets"."lifecycle_status" IN ('DRAFT', 'REVIEW', 'CANCELLED')
        OR ("markets"."terms_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "markets"."terms_frozen_at" IS NOT NULL)

wallet_link_challenges_payload_check.name: wallet_link_challenges_payload_check
wallet_link_challenges_payload_check.value:
(
    jsonb_typeof("wallet_link_challenges"."typed_data") = 'object'
    AND "wallet_link_challenges"."typed_data"->>'primaryType' = 'WalletLink'
    AND "wallet_link_challenges"."typed_data" #>> '{domain,name}' = 'KhmerFP Wallet Ownership'
    AND "wallet_link_challenges"."typed_data" #>> '{domain,version}' = '1'
    AND "wallet_link_challenges"."typed_data" #>> '{domain,chainId}' = "wallet_link_challenges"."chain_id"::text
    AND "wallet_link_challenges"."typed_data" #>> '{message,challengeId}' = "wallet_link_challenges"."id"::text
    AND "wallet_link_challenges"."typed_data" #>> '{message,userId}' = "wallet_link_challenges"."user_id"::text
    AND "wallet_link_challenges"."typed_data" #>> '{message,wallet}' = "wallet_link_challenges"."wallet_address"::text
    AND "wallet_link_challenges"."typed_data" #>> '{message,action}' = "wallet_link_challenges"."action"
    AND "wallet_link_challenges"."typed_data" #>> '{message,appOrigin}' = "wallet_link_challenges"."app_origin"
    AND "wallet_link_challenges"."typed_data" #>> '{message,nonce}' = "wallet_link_challenges"."nonce"::text
  ) IS TRUE

financial_accounts_kind_check.name: financial_accounts_kind_check
financial_accounts_kind_check.value: ("financial_accounts"."kind" = 'CUSTOMER' AND "financial_accounts"."owner_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "financial_accounts"."normal_side" = 'CREDIT') OR ("financial_accounts"."kind" IN ('ASSET','EQUITY','REVENUE','EXPENSE','CLEARING') AND "financial_accounts"."owner_user_id" IS NULL AND "financial_accounts"."normal_side" IN ('DEBIT','CREDIT'))

financial_assets_identity_check.name: financial_assets_identity_check
financial_assets_identity_check.value: ("financial_assets"."code" = 'USD' AND "financial_assets"."decimals" = 2 AND "financial_assets"."enabled") OR ("financial_assets"."code" = 'USDC' AND "financial_assets"."decimals" = 6 AND NOT "financial_assets"."enabled")

position_accounts_kind_check.name: position_accounts_kind_check
position_accounts_kind_check.value: ("position_accounts"."kind"='CUSTOMER' AND "position_accounts"."owner_user_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("position_accounts"."kind" IN ('UNALLOCATED','EXTERNAL_CONTROL') AND "position_accounts"."owner_user_id" IS NULL)

position_reservations_units_check.name: position_reservations_units_check
position_reservations_units_check.value: "position_reservations"."quantity">0 AND "position_reservations"."consumed">=0 AND "position_reservations"."released">=0 AND "position_reservations"."quantity"%1000000=0 AND "position_reservations"."consumed"%1000000=0 AND "position_reservations"."released"%1000000=0 AND "position_reservations"."consumed"::numeric+"position_reservations"."released"<="position_reservations"."quantity"

trading_orders_terms_check.name: trading_orders_terms_check
trading_orders_terms_check.value: "trading_orders"."side" IN ('BUY','SELL') AND "trading_orders"."limit_price_cents" BETWEEN 1 AND 99 AND "trading_orders"."original_quantity">0 AND "trading_orders"."original_quantity"%1000000=0 AND "trading_orders"."filled_quantity">=0 AND "trading_orders"."filled_quantity"%1000000=0 AND "trading_orders"."cancelled_quantity">=0 AND "trading_orders"."cancelled_quantity"%1000000=0 AND "trading_orders"."filled_quantity"::numeric+"trading_orders"."cancelled_quantity"<="trading_orders"."original_quantity"
